reason: Provides on-demand visual analysis for image and document attachments while preserving DSH minimal-mode context and invoking a configured vision service through Bash.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 极简模式提供按需图像与文档视觉分析，并通过 Bash 工作流调用已配置的视觉服务。
summaries.en: Provides on-demand visual analysis for image and document attachments in DSH minimal mode through a Bash workflow and a configured vision service.

capabilities: Normalizes images and stores attachments in a local cache
Invokes a configured external vision service for selected images through a Bash workflow
Supports visual analysis tasks such as slide review, figure semantics, caption grounding, and flowchart extraction
